latest.title: Spec-Driven Development vs Vibe Coding: Why Kiro Bets on Writing It Down
latest.description: While exploratory "vibe coding" is excellent for fast prototyping, it relies on ephemeral chat threads that often lead to context loss and codebase bloat over time. To solve this, the AI platform Kiro champions "spec-driven development," a structured approach that translates explicit intent into version-controlled requirements and designs before any code is generated.

trending.title: AIdeas Finalist: ASET – Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth
trending.description:
ASET (Academic Safety and Evidencing Truth) is a scientific claim verification engine built  for the AI era — where information can be generated instantly, but trust cannot, to address the growing problem of hallucinated citations and  AI-generated information.

Instead of probabilistic prediction, ASET retrieves, analyzes, and synthesizes evidence from 1.2M+ indexed research papers to produce literature-backed verification reports for claims extracted from text, documents, webpages, images, and videos.

trending.description: Global Impact AI Navigator (GIAN) is a multi-agent AI platform built on Amazon Bedrock that transforms a raw idea into a complete strategic package in under 60 seconds — SWOT diagnostic, live-grounded funding discovery, personalized roadmap, and a context-aware advisor.
